title: Zesty Char Welsh Apples Bangers And Mash
description: A vegetarian-friendly Welsh dish featuring char-grilled apples and bouncy vegetarian sausages, served with mashed potatoes and a zesty sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Peel and chop the potatoes into large chunks and boil in salted water until tender.
Meanwhile, slice the onion and mince the garlic.
Brush the apples with olive oil and grill until slightly charred.
Grill the vegetarian sausages according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, salt, and black pepper to make the zesty sauce.
Mash the boiled potatoes with a fork and mix in the sliced onion and minced garlic.
To serve, place the mashed potatoes on a plate, top with a grilled sausage, a char-grilled apple slice, and spoon the zesty sauce over the top.
